title: Imran borrows Master's phone for one minute but chaos happens
custom_script:
# Scene: home (sitting)
Imran: Master, can I borrow your phone? Just one minute! [happy, wave]
Master: One minute only. {sweat} Don't touch anything! [suspicious, point]
Imran: {phone} Hello Mom? {gasp} Oops, I pressed something. [surprised, shrug]
Master: What did you press?! {scared} [surprised, hips, scream]
Imran: {look-around} Just… "send to all contacts." [sad, shrug, fail]
# Time skip: One minute later…
# Scene: street
Master: Two hundred people saw my baby photo! {cry} [sad, shrug]
Imran: {giggle} You looked so cute in that diaper! [happy, point]
Master: {angry} Give me that phone! [angry, hips, crash]
Imran: {walk-out} Bye, cutie! [happy, wave, footsteps]
